scope: production cutover of forward drizzle v2: runner wiring, host CPU fallback port, band-level resume through the gate-7 store, real production runs, then removal of the legacy record/sort/candidate path. Ends the unpublished-prototype phase.

wiring_contract.selection: env var TC_FORWARD_DRIZZLE_V2=1 selects the v2 producer in the FORWARD_DRIZZLE phase during acceptance; the choice is recorded in the v2 run plan and run provenance. After acceptance the legacy path is removed unconditionally and no user-facing switch remains.
wiring_contract.store: the durable artifact is the gate-7 v2 store (forward_drizzle_v2 store root inside artifacts): plan.json + band-%04d.bin pixel records + band-%04d.profiles.bin profile records + checkpoint.json + commit.json + current.json. No legacy FITS profile store is written by v2 runs.
wiring_contract.band_artifact_extension: commit_band gains a profiles payload: band-%04d.profiles.bin carries ForwardDrizzleV2ProfileResult records (80 B) in the same order as the pixel records; ForwardDrizzleV2BandCommit gains profiles_artifact/profiles_bytes/profiles_sha256; both files commit atomically inside the same band transaction before the checkpoint update. Stores without profiles remain readable (affine/uniform-only runs).
wiring_contract.multiband_phase: the MULTIBAND phase auto-detects the v2 store (current.json under the v2 store root) and drives fuse_multiband_streamed over committed band records adapted via forward_drizzle_v2_profiles_to_uniform_result; alpha planes come from forward_drizzle_v2_profile_alpha_plane with channel-min semantics; the stripe-boundary flood-fill caveat is unchanged.
wiring_contract.resume: mid-phase failure resumes at the committed band prefix via inspect_forward_drizzle_v2_store + adopt(); partially written band artifacts are unverifiable and recomputed; the phase checkpoint records the v2 plan_hash so a config/plan change fails closed.
wiring_contract.fallback: FORWARD_DRIZZLE_V2 runs CUDA when available; on a device error the uncommitted generation is discarded and the whole phase restarts on the host CPU port (section 21.4 contract: same artifacts, same band store, bit-identical discrete decisions, magnitudes within documented tolerance). The CPU port must be bounded-memory (same banding and reservoir caps as the device path).

inputs.sources: VerifiedNormalizedSourceCache rows via the existing rect provider contract
inputs.quality: SourceQualityMapCacheReader supplies q_composite/q_scale0/q_scale1/q_artifact source-resolution planes per frame (missing streams fold to 1.0)
inputs.sigma2: host-computed per source pixel via forward_drizzle_v2_sigma2_model: sigma_noise from FrameMetrics.noise (source quality metrics), sigma_reg from star_residuals rms_px (global registration), gradient = central differences of the normalized source; missing inputs produce an absent sigma2 stream (n_eff fallback)
inputs.frame_meta: g_eff from the quality frame weight plan, is_direct = !model_predicted && model_prediction_factor==1.0, residual_factor = registration_residual_factor
inputs.geometry: affine frames take source_to_canvas; has_smooth_local_model frames take accumulate_frame_local with the persisted SmoothLocalWarpModel; per-frame discard policy counts against local_samples_discarded

wiring_contract.output_grid: v2 stores at the native output grid; supported configs require output resolution == native canvas (internal_scale=2/output_scale=1 and 1/1); 2/2 is rejected at plan time

cpu_port_contract.semantics: host port of the device pipeline: per-source-sample warp evaluation (affine inverse or local model), polygon-rectangle droplet clip, b_src/b_geo/quality accumulation into the same plane roles, hash reservoir with identical keep predicate and 2R slot cap, deterministic overflow fallback, finalize = bit-identical clip/alpha/profile reduction to the device path
cpu_port_contract.tolerance: discrete decisions, support masks, kept sets, clip masks and profile support bit-identical to the device path; magnitudes within 1e-12 relative (no atomic-order drift on a serial host loop)
cpu_port_contract.performance: no bound: the fallback exists for contract survival on machines without a usable device, not for throughput; it must still be bounded-memory and stream frames sequentially

runs.mode: affine-only (local refinement disabled or naturally absent)
local refinement enabled; acceptance requires local_model_samples_total > 0
local refinement enabled, distinct drizzle params (pixfrac 1.0 or levels=4)

production_run_matrix.notes: every run is a complete cold pipeline (scan -> registration -> quality -> FORWARD_DRIZZLE -> MULTIBAND -> downstream); a run whose sampling plan yields zero local-model frames does not count as a local acceptance; if M42 stops producing local frames an alternate dataset with applied local models must be substituted

acceptance_gates.store: every v2 run ends with a published current.json; verify via inspect_forward_drizzle_v2_store == complete; commit gate nonfinite_pixels_inside_source_support == 0
acceptance_gates.scaling: frame-dependent work linear in N; reserved device bytes constant across N; no N log N per pixel; RA <= 1.1 with reuse accounting reported per run
acceptance_gates.telemetry: 0 hotpath allocations, 0 global device synchronizations, max_frame_seconds < 0.75 on production geometry
acceptance_gates.validation: matched-star selection runs on v2 outputs; uniform and raw remain immutable controls; multiband promotion still requires strict improvement over raw
acceptance_gates.cpu_fallback: a forced device failure mid-phase produces a CPU-restarted run whose committed band records match the CUDA run's discrete state bit-for-bit and magnitudes within 1e-12
acceptance_gates.resume: SIGKILL mid-FORWARD_DRIZZLE then resume: the run completes, band artifacts at/after the kill point are recomputed, committed prefix reused verbatim (checkpoint_hash equality against the uninterrupted run where the plan binds it)
acceptance_gates.errors: corrupt band artifact (bit flip, truncation, missing file), non-contiguous checkpoint, foreign plan context, ambiguous generations all fail closed on resume

required: configuration_reference.md/_en.md: record the v2 cutover state and the removed legacy path
methodology docs: architecture doc gate-10 section + gate table updated
report labels: runs record backend_used=cuda_v2/cpu_v2 and the v2 store identity
examples/README updated where they reference the reconstruction internals

legacy_removal.precondition: all production runs passed and the decision artifact is written
legacy_removal.removes: the record/sort/candidate producer path (ClipCandidate streaming, per-pixel candidate lists, legacy CUDA stripe path, CPU streaming reduction, persist_forward_drizzle_* entry points) and the legacy FITS profile store writer once no consumer remains
legacy_removal.keeps: fuse_multiband*/multiband_validation machinery (shared), the normalized source cache, quality map cache, and everything upstream of FORWARD_DRIZZLE
legacy_removal.constraint: removal is the final commit of the gate; it is not part of the acceptance runs

test_matrix.unit: CPU port parity vs device on the small-canvas matrix (scale 1/2, MONO/OSC, all bayer patterns, local warps, N>R, invalid models); profile artifact round-trip; checkpoint schema with and without profiles
test_matrix.integration: v2 store -> fuse_multiband_streamed parity against the gate-9 whole-frame oracle; band-resume mid-stream; commit-gate rejection; corrupt-artifact matrix on the extended band format
test_matrix.runner: FORWARD_DRIZZLE phase with TC_FORWARD_DRIZZLE_V2=1 produces the v2 store; MULTIBAND auto-detects and fuses; phase checkpoint carries plan_hash; env unset keeps legacy path (until removal)
